translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Ikowake Pablo iri aminakoterine César
Pinkathariwentantake Festo. Iro awisanake mawa kiteesheri jatake Jerusalén-ki ipoñaanakawo Cesarea-ki.
Ikanta reeware Imperatasorentsitaarewo itsipayetakari iriiperori Judá-ite, ithawetakotawakeri Pablo.
Ikowakotakeri rotyaantairi Pablo Jerusalén-ki. Ikenkithashiryagaiyakani ritsitokakaanteri niyankithakineki awotsi.
Ari ikantanake Festo: “Tema romonkyagaitakeri Pablo Cesarea-ki, irootaintsi niyaatai janta.
Royaatanakena itzinkami, tzimatsirika iyenakaashitane jirika atziri, ari piyakowenteri janta.”
Te osamanitzi risaikawaitapaintzi Festo janta Jerusalén-ki, piyaawo Cesarea-ki. Okanta risaikamanai risaikamentoki ipinkathariwentantzira, ikaimakaantakeri Pablo.
Ikanta ikyaapaake Pablo, ari ripokaiyapaakeni Judá-ite poñaayetainchari Jerusalén-ki, ikantakowaitapaakeri osheki kaariperori, okantaweta te iñaayewetawo imaperotatyaarika ikantakoitziriri.

Kenkithatakotanaka Pablo, ikantake: “Tekaatsi kaariperori nante naaka, te nipiyathatawo Inintakaantaitakeniriri nosheninkapaini, te nowaariperotero tasorentsipanko, te nokaweyawaitziri César reewariperote Roma-satzi.”
Iriima pinkathari Festo ikowira raapatziyapiintyaari Judá-ite, rosampitanakeri Pablo: “¿Pikowima piyaate Jerusalén-ki, nonkemantyaariri yakowentemine janta?”
Ikantanake Pablo: “Iro kameethatatsi nisaike jaka paminakotena, tema eerokatake rowakeri César reewariperote Roma-satzi. Piyotaiyakeni tekaatsi kaariperori nantzimoteriri nosheninkapaini Judá-ite.
Ontzimatyeeme noyenakaashiperotane, kameethatakeme ritsitokaitena. Tema tekaatsi nonkenakaashitya, te okameethatzi potyaantena janta. Nokowaperotzi iri pinkathari César aminakoperotenane.”
Ikanta Festo ikenkithawaitakaakeri ikaataiyini ipinkatharitzi. Ari ikantanakeri: “Iroorika pikowi raminakotemi César, ari nosankenatakotakemi, piyaatantyaari janta.”
Ragaitanakeri Pablo pinkathariki Agripa
Ikanta pinkathari Agripa itsipatakawo iina Berenice pokaiyakeni Cesarea-ki, riwethatyaari Festo.
Ikanta risaikawaitapaintzi janta, ikenkithawaitakaakeri Festo tsika ikantakota Pablo, ikantakeri: “Eenitatsi apaani atziri rookanairi pinkathari Félix romonkyagaitziri.
Niyaatake chapinkipaiteki Jerusalén-ki, osheki ikantakowaitawakeri reeware Imperatasorentsitaarewo itsipayetakari Itzinkamipaini, ikowakotakena nitsitokakaanteri.

Nokantanakeri naaka: ‘Jiroka nametaiyarini No-roma-satzitzira: Ontzimatye impiyotaiyaani ikaatzi koshekawakaachari, ompoñaantyaari inkenkithatakotantyaariri riyakowentanewo. Kyaaryooperorika otzimi iyenakaashitane, aritake ritsitokaitakeri.’
Irootake nantakeri ripokaiyakenira irirori, te nishenkaanaka, jatakena nisaikamentoki, nokaimakaantakeri atzirika.
Iro kantzimaitacha okaatzi ikantapaakeri yakowentziriri, te noñiiro onkantaperotya okaatzi nokenkithashiryaakowetakariri.
Apatziro ikenkithatakotashitakawo ikemisantashiwaiyetari, ikenkithatakotakeri eejatzi iitaitziri Jesús rowamagaitakeri, iriitake ikantziri Pablo eeniro rañi.
Temaita niyotzi jimpe nonkantero jiroka, nosampitakeri Pablo ikowirika riyaate Jerusalén-ki raminakoitantyaariri janta.
Ikowaperotake Pablo iriitake aminakoperoterine César Augusto awinkathariperote Roma-ki. Irootake nokantantakari riyaatatziira romonkyagaiteri irojatzi notyaantantakyaariri.”
Ikanta Agripa, ikantanakeri Festo: “Nokowi nonkemeri naaka jirika atziri.” Ikantanake Festo: “Aritake pinkemakeri onkiteeshetamanai.”

Okanta okiteeshetamanai, ikyaake Agripa itsipatakawo Berenice, owaneenka ikantayetaka. Itsipayetakari reeware owayeripaini, eejatzi iriiperoripaini atziri saikayetatsiri janta. Ikantake Festo ramaiteniri Pablo.

Ari ikenkithawaitanakeri Festo, ikantzi: “Pinkathari Agripa, pinkatharipaini ikaatzi piyotainchari jaka, jirika atziri. Osheki riyakowentakeri Judá-ite janta Jerusalén-ki eejatzi jaka Cesarea-ki. Richeraapiintaiyini ikowi ritsitokaiteri.
Noñiimaitakawo naaka tekaatsi inkenakaashitya jirika ritsitokantaityaariri. Iri kantzimaitacha, iri kowanaintsiri raminakoperoteri Augusto, iri kameethatatsi notyaanteri janta.

Temaita noñe naaka oita nosankenateniriri pinkathariperori ikantakota jirika, iroowa namantzimiriri eerokapaini piñeeri, eerokaga pinkathari Agripa namakeniri, posampitawakeri, ari ontzimeri nosankenateri.
Te onkameethatzimotena notyaante apaani romonkyagaitziri, eerorika otzimi tsika osankenatakota iyenakaashitane.”

footnotes.text: Kantakotachari jaka “te osamanitzi”, irojatzi ikantakoitziri 8 aamaakarika 10 kiteesheri risaikawaitapaintzi.
